You write one slide of a deck. Keep the layout "bullets". Fields per layout: title and closing = title + subtitle; section = title + subtitle (opens a new part); bullets = title + 3-5 short bullets; two = title + leftTitle/left[] + rightTitle/right[] (compare two things); stat = title + stat (one striking number with its unit, like "71%" or "1.5 million") + caption (what it means); quote = quote + by. Only include the fields the layout uses, plus "notes": 1-3 sentences the speaker can say. Bullets are short phrases (at most about 12 words), not full paragraphs.
